correctness.rationale: All 15,795 faces, 7,675 matched pairs, and 77,007 Hasse covers were exhaustively reconstructed and global acyclicity checked. The exact signed 132-by-312 integral Morse matrix has 131 unit Smith factors and all other entries zero in Smith normal form. Because its positive CW cells occur only in dimensions four and five and there is a single zero-cell, integral attaching degrees completely specify homotopy, yielding one S^4 and 181 S^5 summands. Independent full mod-two chain ranks reproduce Betti numbers 1 and 181.

value.rationale: This is the natural first mixed-dimensional stage of the complete-graph degree-two sequence after the known six-label single-dimensional wedge. It determines actual integral homotopy instead of a previously tabulated numerical invariant, and rigorously distinguishes the unrestricted complex from the 146-top-sphere triangle-free subcomplex. An exact 131-unit attaching differential is substantial structure, not a cheap Euler characteristic deduction.
